data.title: 泽塔 · 冬夜屋顶的监视
data.description: 冬夜，泽塔蹲在学园屋顶的阴影里俯瞰灯火。金色的长尾在寒风中轻轻摆动，她把教团今晚的动向一一记下，一言不发。
data.location: snowy academy rooftop at night overlooking warm window lights below
data.action: crouching on a rooftop edge watching the academy below, cat ears twitching, long golden tail swaying in winter wind
data.lighting: 雪夜屋顶的清冷月光与楼下温暖的窗光
data.promptProse: On a winter rooftop, Zeta watches the academy lights in silence, memorizing the cult's movements one by one.
data.animaCaption: The time has come — Zeta's whisper is lost to the winter wind, but her eyes miss nothing.
